name: card_description_render
description: CARDS tab renders each battle card type's banked description under its row. Regression lock for s_card_desc_blob: a flat multi-literal array initializer is silently miscompiled by SDCC to 'first row + zero fill', which blanked every non-sword description while all tests stayed green. Grants WOOD_RING so the HEAL row renders too. BOW is deliberately uncovered: no catalog card maps to BATTLE_CARD_TYPE_BOW (attacks are SWORD-typed; BOW exists only in enemy deck tables, which never render descriptions).
